angleRead.name: Sharon Okafor
angleRead.text: I'm heading over to Piedmont Ave to see what's actually left of the Lena Cross era. She was global, but now she's just another name in the 'where-are-they-now' pile. I want to see if she's still ordering the same thing at the cafe or if she's pretending not to see the people who remember her peak. While I'm there, I'll keep an eye out for Rowan Pierce; two fading lights on the same stretch of road usually have a story about how the slide happens. I'm looking for the gap between the fame they used to have and the quiet they've got now.
